meta.what: Nightmare Creatures, spawn kinds and other named creatures
meta.denominator: Shadow Slave paid-claim census: every creature record id mentioned in at least 3 census windows (ss.creature.*), merged by id; echoes and shadows have their own ledger or are kept as creatures where the census files them so
meta.split_rule: Rows are ordered by sha1 of "nextcells-v1:<id>"; those whose first hex byte is below 0x40 are the tuning sample, the only rows the prompt or normaliser may be adjusted on; every other row is held out and reported. Dial: seed and fraction; the fixed seed is the reported one.

class_map.baseline: majority class among labelled held-out rows (computed at build)

meta.label: the Nightmare Creature rank word (Dormant, Awakened, Corrupted, Fallen...) stated in the record, hidden; the class word (Beast, Monster, Demon, Devil, Tyrant, Terror, Titan) is kept as a stated field
meta.fold_rule: A guessed class becomes a sheet field only where held-out hits beat the majority baseline over the labelled held-out rows (PWC2); otherwise the sheet drops it and the note says model tier, unchecked.

score.label: the Nightmare Creature rank word (Dormant, Awakened, Corrupted, Fallen...) stated in the record, hidden; the class word (Beast, Monster, Demon, Devil, Tyrant, Terror, Titan) is kept as a stated field

fold.class_guess: not folded (does not beat the majority class on held-out rows)
